title: DesignDiagnostic
description: Standardized diagnostic output from any Design Critic validator. This is the contract between Critic → Correction Engine → Orchestrator.

issue_id.description: Categorized issue ID: A11Y=accessibility, VIS=visual, UX=experience, PERF=performance, CONV=conversion

category.description: High-level category for routing and reporting

severity.description: Critical=block delivery, High=auto-correct, Medium=correct if safe, Low=log only

measured_value.description: Actual measured value (contrast ratio, LCP ms, pixel diff %, etc.)

required_value.description: Threshold or target value from validation config

suggested_action.description: Specific corrective action (e.g., 'Darken background overlay to #1E3A8A', 'Add width/height to image')

auto_fix_allowed.description: Whether Correction Engine may attempt automatic fix

verification_required.description: Whether fix must be re-validated (always true for critical/high)

brand_constraint.description: Brand token or rule that constrains fixes (e.g., 'brand.primary', 'token:cta.primary_bg')

regression_check.description: Selectors or scopes to re-check after fix to catch side effects
